title: Accepted Syntax Has a CNF Representation
statement: For every bit string $x$, if the syntax automaton accepts $x$, then there are bit strings $q$ and a CNF formula $\varphi$ over natural-number-indexed variables such that $x=\langle q,\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)\rangle$, where the pairing is the self-delimiting encoding and $\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)$ is the specified binary serialization of the formula.
